name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Operations Strategy & Systems Builder | Process Design, Automation & AI, Data Analysis
summary: Operator who fixes processes by going to the source: running the workflow, reading the data, and building the system that makes the fix stick. 15+ years across SaaS operations, onboarding, and sales, including two years leading a team of 20 (later 8) at Wix and co-founding an operations-heavy business from scratch. Today I design and deploy automation and AI agent workflows in production, write SQL for BigQuery and Power BI, and script custom code steps in Python and JavaScript. Remote since 2020.

bullets: Break manual workflows down into automated and AI-agent architectures with custom logic, deploying 20+ production workflows spanning intake, routing, qualification, scheduling, no-show recovery, and reactivation.
Build integrations with webhooks, batch data imports, and custom Python and JavaScript code steps in Zapier, Make, and n8n.
Design evaluation loops and rubric-based grading to monitor AI output quality, and personally label data to keep the systems accurate.
Build dashboards tracking funnel progression, ROI, and pipeline velocity using SQL on BigQuery/GA4 data and Power BI.
Traced a client's lead-quality problem past the ad account to the real bottleneck (on-site conversion), fixing the root cause instead of the symptom.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
